text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic photographic studio character asset, natural skin pores and fine individual hair, realistic cotton and knit detail. Pure white seamless background, bright soft frontal daylight balanced fill, low shadows, realistic 50mm lens perspective, no plastic skin, no illustration or 3D, no text or labels or logos.  One original fictional adult man. White European man with short messy chestnut waves, gray-blue eyes, tiny silver hoop earring and one discreet eyebrow piercing, relaxed rebellious charm, plain washed black tee without print. Facial design: elongated oval face, broad rounded jaw, long thin curved brows, wide-set gentle hooded eyes, slightly aquiline longer nose with softly rounded tip, broad mouth with delicate upper lip and full lower lip. Neutral fair skin, subtle friendly half smile. Washed black tee, small silver hoop and discreet eyebrow piercing, charcoal relaxed jeans, black lace-up ankle boots. Lean athletic 188cm build. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
